procedural_matters: Johan Emmer , coach boat 323 attended the hearing
facts: On 8th June 2025, the race committeedisplayed D flag for 420 class at 11:47.
Johan Emmer, Coach 323 was watching the boatsgoing afloat by the observatory tower in front of the club
From that viewpoint, Johan Emmer saw GER 57398 immediatelyout of the harbor, waving their arms seeking help.
Johan Emmer is the coach of GER 57398
Immediately after, Johan Emmer went afloat, andthe rib speed was clearly above 3 knots.
After assisting GER 57398, Johan Emmer returnedto the marina to complete the briefing with the other sailors of his team.
After the briefing, Johan Emmer left the harboragain to go to the racing area E in compliance with the harbor speed limit.
The Kiel-Schilksee Olympic marina harbor mastersaw a rib leaving the harbor at excessive speed
The harbor master identified the boat as the coachrib 323 belonging to Johan Emmer
After the last race of the day, Johan Emmer cameashore, and the harbor master informed him that he was speeding in the harborand that the rib will be taken out of the water.
conclusions: By driving the rib above 3 knots in the harbor JohanEmmer, failed to comply with local harbor and marina regulation and broke rule YES 2025 - EVENT SUPPORT TEAM REGULATIONS (ESTR) 3.6
decision: Johan Emmer, coach 323, is warned under RRS 62.4 that a penalty may be imposed to his sailors if Johan Emmer commits a further breach of any rule.
In addition, Johanne Emmer shall write a formal apology to the harbor master today.
